import math

def is_power_of_p(N, p):
    """Checks if N is a power of p (i.e., N = p^k for some k >= 1)."""
    if N <= 0:
        return False
    if N == 1:
        return p == 1 # Should not happen since p > 2
    
    # Check divisibility by p until we reach 1
    while N > 1 and N % p == 0:
        N //= p
    
    return N == 1

def test_case(p, a, b):
    """Checks if both conditions are met for a given (p, a, b)."""
    
    # Condition 1: a^(p-1) + b is a power of p
    N1 = a**(p - 1) + b
    is_N1_power = is_power_of_p(N1, p)
    
    # Condition 2: b^(p-1) + a is a power of p
    N2 = b**(p - 1) + a
    is_N2_power = is_power_of_p(N2, p)
    
    return is_N1_power and is_N2_power, N1, N2

We analyze the system of equations:

Taking the equations modulo $p$:
1. $1 + b \equiv 0 \pmod{p} \implies b \equiv -1 \equiv p-1 \pmod{p}$.
2. $1 + a \equiv 0 \pmod{p} \implies a \equiv -1 \equiv p-1 \pmod{p}$.
